# Optional Payroll Field Templates

Date: 2026-05-26

## Added

- Optional payroll field template catalog.
- Setup page at `/setup/field-templates`.
- Activation workflow that creates `UserDefinedFieldDefinition` records for a selected company.
- Navigation link under Setup.
- Documentation and tests.

## Safety Notes

ClearPath Payroll does not provide legal, tax, financial, accounting, or payroll compliance advice. Templates are optional local setup aids and are not activated automatically. This feature does not submit ACH, submit tax filings, call production APIs, or change payroll calculation logic.
